title: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE Hood Repaint and Grille Replacement
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair repainted the hood and replaced the front grille on a 2017 Toyota Camry XSE.
story: This 2017 Toyota Camry XSE came to Carcis Autobody Repair for front-end service, focusing on the hood and front grille. Front-end components frequently sustain damage from road debris, stone chips, and minor impacts, requiring targeted refinishing and component replacement.

Our technicians replaced the damaged front grille assembly with a fresh factory unit to ensure proper fitment and alignment with the surrounding bumper and headlights. Replacing the grille restores both the vehicle's structural airflow profile and its original front-end styling.

For the hood, the panel was sanded, prepped, and repainted to match the factory black finish. Refinishing a hood requires precise paint matching, clean clear coat application, and thorough curing to achieve a smooth, high-gloss surface without imperfections.
